title: Global Sports Headlines: Federer Honored, Arsenal's Transfer Moves, and More
flags: Roger Federer Inducted into Tennis Hall of Fame
According to **BBC Sport**, tennis icon Roger Federer was inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in a tearful ceremony. Federer described it as "one of the greatest honors" of his life.
Pakistan’s Muhammad Abbas made history with a five-wicket haul at Lord’s, bowling England out for 208. **BBC Sport** highlights his inclusion on the Lord’s honors board.
